info.name: IDB Invest - Offboarding Databricks Facade
info.description: Functional and contract tests for the Offboarding Databricks Facade. English is the default language for names, scripts, messages, and documentation.

exec: pm.variables.set('correlationId', 'postman-' + pm.variables.replaceIn('{{$guid}}'));
pm.test('HTTP status is 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Response is JSON', function () { pm.response.to.be.json; });
pm.test('Health payload contains status', function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('status'); });
pm.test('Response time is below 10 seconds', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.responseTime).to.be.below(10000); });
pm.test('HTTP status is 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Metadata identifies the employees resource', function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.resource).to.eql('employees'); });

pm.test('Metadata exposes fields and maximum page size', function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.fields).to.be.an('array').that.is.not.empty; pm.expect(body.maxPageSize).to.be.a('number'); });
pm.test('Metadata does not expose physical Databricks source', function () { const raw = pm.response.text(); pm.expect(raw).not.to.include('gold.offboarding.vw_employees'); });
pm.test('HTTP status is 404', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(404); });

pm.test('Error contract contains code and correlationId', function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('code'); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('correlationId'); });

item.name: Query employees with filters and paging

exec: pm.test('HTTP status is 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Response follows query envelope contract', function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.data).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(body.meta).to.be.an('object'); });

pm.test('Paging metadata is present', function () { const meta = pm.response.json().meta; pm.expect(meta.page).to.eql(1); pm.expect(meta.pageSize).to.eql(100); pm.expect(meta).to.have.property('returned'); pm.expect(meta).to.have.property('hasMore'); });
pm.test('Correlation ID is returned in metadata', function () { const meta = pm.response.json().meta; pm.expect(meta.correlationId).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });

pm.test('Physical Databricks identifiers are not exposed', function () { const raw = pm.response.text(); pm.expect(raw).not.to.include('vw_employees'); pm.expect(raw).not.to.include('employee_id'); });
pm.test('HTTP status is 400', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); });

pm.test('Invalid query uses normalized error contract', function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.code).to.eql('INVALID_QUERY'); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('message'); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('correlationId'); });

item.name: Page size above resource limit is rejected

exec: pm.test('HTTP status is 400', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); });
pm.test('Error code is INVALID_QUERY', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().code).to.eql('INVALID_QUERY'); });
